Final head for L1 (p1) · area a4-U · 2026-11-25T12:04Z
Head-sha: `eab0575f6dd776f18df91c471438cff16ecec255`

Card #37259. Dev report: 7161424954.

- **Root cause:** `groupFilterChips` built the comparand as `String(comparand)`, and `ObjectDataPage` drew that half without a label; only the field half went through `fieldLabel`.
- **Fix:**
  - `groupFilterChips` takes an optional `comparandText(field, value)`, which defaults to `String`. It applies to equality, `[ne]` and each member of `[in]`/`[nin]`.
  - Range bounds and text-operator fragments stay raw.
  - `ObjectDataPage` passes a labeller built on the grid cell's own path: `useObjectLabel().translateOptions(...)`, then an exact-value match drawn with core's `optionDisplayLabel`.
  - An unmatched comparand stays raw.
  - Chips are now computed per render, like `fieldLabel`, rather than in a `useMemo`.
- **Pins,** in the page-level chip harness `ObjectDataPage.filterChipI18n-9159.test.tsx`:
  - zh equality, en equality, `[in]` and `[ne]`;
  - three controls: unknown comparand, `contains` fragment, non-option field.
- **Red on main:** with both sources restored from `1b91538bb2`, 4 tests fail and 13 pass. The 4 failures are the four label cases; the controls are green on both sides by design.
- **Ablation:** `return option ? optionDisplayLabel(option) : raw;` → `return raw;` gives the same 4 failures. It was restored to blob == HEAD.
- **Readings, from the dev:**
  - pins 99 of 99;
  - app-shell ObjectDataPage* and drill* 241 of 241;
  - app-shell type-check exit 0;
  - `ui` `scripts/` 172 passed;
  - 38 of 38 dispatch-gates commands exit 0.
- **Not measured:** a browser repro through the dashboard drill (a shared-lock hold). The page-level harness renders the zh translation, which is the visible surface the card names.
- **Out of scope, in Acceptance notes, not filed:**
  - Boolean comparands still read `= true`/`= false`, and lookup comparands still read as the id. The card names both as out of scope.
  - Matching is exact, unlike the grid's case-insensitive fallback. This is deliberate, because the comparand is the server filter.
- **Size:** +162 −15 across 4 files, not governed.
- **Check-runs at this head:** 38 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing or pending.
- **K:** 15 against current main. Main will be merged through the relay's `pr_update_branch` before landing; a merge-only head move keeps an ACCEPT.

Handed to the seat session for L1.

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `eab0575f6dd776f18df91c471438cff16ecec255` · 2026-11-25T12:20Z

- **Shape:** draft PR into `main`. The body's first line is `Fixes #37259`, and the whole card is delivered, so `Fixes` is right. No closing keyword sits beside any other open card number. 4 files, +162/−15, not governed. Base `1b91538bb2`, K=15 against `origin/main` `4ed453dc21`.
- **Root cause, not a mask:** the premise holds. On base, `groupFilterChips` drew the comparand bare: `String(comparand)` in the word arm (the card's `:723`) and `String(list[0][2])` in the `=` arm. The page then drew `text` raw, and only the field half went through `fieldLabel`. The fix adds an optional `comparandText(field, value)` (default `String`) used by both arms. The page passes a labeller with this flow:
  - it reads the field's **declared** `options` from `objectDef.fields[field]`;
  - `useObjectLabel().translateOptions(objectDef.name, field, options)` runs it through the current-language catalogue, the same call the grid makes (`plugin-grid/objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx`);
  - an exact-value match is drawn with core's `optionDisplayLabel`.

  So the label comes from the declared options, in the user's locale.
- **Edge cases, read from the source at head:**
  - **Unknown value:** shown raw, and pinned (`= legacy_code`).
  - **Multi-select:** declares `options`, so an `=` comparand or each `[in]`/`[nin]` member is labelled one by one, and an unmatched member stays raw in the joined list.
  - **Boolean:** `[bool]=true` reads back as `[f,'=',true]`. With no `options` it falls to `String`, so the chip still reads `= true`. The card puts this out of scope, and the changeset says "unchanged", which is accurate.
  - **Lookup:** still the record id, except the related-list `source.t` chip that exists today. The card names lookups as out of scope ("probably want … out of scope here"), so out of scope is confirmed.
  - **i18n-map label:** cannot be authored. `SelectOptionSchema.label` is `z.string()` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:381`), and translation goes only through the catalogue, which `translateOptions` already covers. If unvalidated runtime metadata carries a non-string label anyway, `optionDisplayLabel` falls back to the value: no throw, and no regression from base.
  - **Text-operator fragments and range bounds:** stay verbatim (`WHOLE_VALUE_OP_WORDS` = `not_equals`/`in`/`not_in`, plus `=`). The `contains` case is pinned.
- **Pins re-run at head** in a throwaway worktree, after `pnpm --filter "@object-ui/app-shell^..." build` (exit 0). `vitest run ObjectDataPage.filterChipI18n-9159.test.tsx drillUrlFilters.test.ts` gave `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 99 passed (99)`, which matches the dev's reading.
- **Red on base:** with both sources restored from `1b91538bb2` and the harness at head: `Tests 4 failed | 13 passed (17)`. The four failures are the zh `=`, en `=`, `[in]` and `[ne]` cases.
- **Ablations,** all run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Every mutation landed and every file was restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty.

  | # | File | Mutation | Result |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | A1 (the dev's) | page | `return option ? optionDisplayLabel(option) : raw;` → `return raw;` | 4 failed |
  | A2 | `drillUrlFilters.ts` | the word-arm `draw` → `String(v)` | 2 failed (`[in]`, `[ne]`) |
  | A3 | `drillUrlFilters.ts` | the `=` arm → `String(list[0][2])` | 2 failed (zh/en `=`) |
  | A4 | `drillUrlFilters.ts` | `'contains'` added to `WHOLE_VALUE_OP_WORDS` | 1 failed (the text-fragment control) |
  | A5 | `drillUrlFilters.ts` | `'not_in'` removed from `WHOLE_VALUE_OP_WORDS` | **99 passed**, see S1 |

- **S1 (should-fix):** the `[nin]` arm is advertised but not pinned.
  - The changeset ("each comparand of an … membership filter") and the PR body ("each member of a membership list (`[in]`, `[nin]`)") both claim it.
  - Ablation A5 removes `not_in` from the set and every pin stays green.
  - The behaviour at head is correct by reading, since `[nin]` goes through the same `draw` as `[in]`.
  - Fix: one `filter[category][nin]=software` case in the `objectstack#37259` describe, expecting `${packLabelOf('zh-Hans','filterBuilder.operators.not_in')} 软件`. Fold it into any patch round; if none happens before landing, carry it on the follow-up card below. It does not block on its own.
- **N1 — exact match vs the grid's matcher:**
  - The labeller matches exactly. The grid's `findDeclaredOption` (`ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx:805`) adds a case-insensitive fallback.
  - So on seed data stored as `Software` against a declared value `software`, the grid reads `软件` while the chip reads `= Software`.
  - The dev disclosed this and gave a reason. Conforming data cannot hit it, because `SelectOptionSchema.value` is a lowercase `SystemIdentifier`.
  - The changeset's "the same text the grid cell shows for that value" is therefore true only for conforming data. That is acceptable, and recorded here.
- **N2 — the changeset's example sentence:** "in zh-CN, `Category = software`" puts the English field label beside a zh locale. The real chip reads `产品类别 = software`. This is cosmetic.
- **Browser repro marked NOT MEASURED (the dev cited a shared-lock hold):**
  - It is weighed as a low residual, not a gap. The harness renders the real `ObjectDataPage` under the real `I18nProvider` and packs, with an app bundle shaped `{ns}.fieldOptions.{object}.{field}.{value}`.
  - The one link left unproven is that a served bundle and `objectDef` reach this page with the same shape. The card's own repro says the grid on this same screen already draws `软件` through the same `translateOptions` call, which covers that link.
  - The zone can glance at HotCRM `product_catalog_dashboard` → `top_products` → 软件 → 在列表中打开 after landing. This does not block.
- **Changeset, sentence by sentence** (`'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`):
  - That package is `private: true` but versioned under `privatePackages.version: true`; 245 changesets on `main` already name it, so this one follows practice.
  - Sentence 1 (bare data page, drill landing, raw value shown): true (see N2).
  - Sentence 2 (equality, does-not-equal and membership drawn as the translated label, "same text as the grid cell"): true at head. `[nin]` is unpinned (S1), and the grid comparison is subject to N1.
  - Sentence 3 (unmatched value stays raw): true and pinned.
  - Sentence 4 (text filters keep their fragment, fields without options unchanged): true; both are pinned.
  - Sentence 5 (boolean and lookup unchanged): true by reading.
- **维护者速读, sentence by sentence:**
  - "选择型字段的筛选标签显示选项的显示名": true. The fix in fact covers any field that declares `options`, which the body's Acceptance notes also say.
  - "为什么做": consistent with the card's p1 rationale.
  - "列表本身的筛选结果不受影响": true. `filterChips` is read only by the chip render (`ObjectDataPage.tsx:1056`). "Save as view" folds `urlFilters` triples, not chip text, and the dropped `useMemo` has no dependents.
  - "要你做什么：无": correct, since nothing is governed.
- **Declarations:**
  - **`Clause-②: no`:** correct. `groupFilterChips`/`ComparandText` are internal to the private `@object-ui/app-shell` and absent from its `src/index.ts`. The new parameter is optional, so no accepted set or public surface widens.
  - **`Metadata-protocol: none`:** correct. Nothing an author writes changes; the change is display only. Both lines appear in the PR body and in the changeset body.
- **Check-runs at `eab0575f6d`:** 51 total, 38 `success` and 13 `skipped`, none failed or pending. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check` and `Type Check UI` are all `success`.
- **Mechanics:**
  - `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main eab0575f6d` is clean (tree `aa7f8be4e5`).
  - The 15 commits on `main` since base touch none of the 4 files, nor `core/evaluator/optionRules.ts` or `i18n/useObjectLabel.ts`.
  - None of the 41 other open PRs touches `ObjectDataPage.tsx`, `drillUrlFilters.ts` or the chip harness.
- **Dev report and zone final:**
  - Dev report 7161424954 (2026-11-25T11:43:53Z) and zone final 7161902302 (2026-11-25T12:05:17Z) both pin this head.
  - Their readings match the seat's own re-runs. The extra `import '@objectstack/lint'` is inside the declared harness, as `check:test-source-alias` requires.
- **Same-family chip and summary producers left raw,** named for one follow-up card (not filed by this seat):
  - (a) **Lookup comparand on `/data`:** a dashboard drill on a lookup dimension shows the record id (`ObjectDataPage` chip, `=`/`[in]` arms). It needs a name resolve.
  - (b) **Boolean comparand on `/data`:** shows `= true`/`= false`. The sibling `FilterConditionField.describeCondition` already uses `filterBuilder.trueLabel`/`falseLabel`.
  - (c) **`FilterConditionField.describeCondition`** (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx:636`, used by the report builder and the metadata-admin dataset and field inspectors): maps options to the **authored** label without `translateOptions`, and draws the field label untranslated.
  - (d) S1's `[nin]` pin, if not folded in before then.
  - Checked and not raw: the saved-filter and condition surfaces `plugin-list` `UserFilters` and `ListConditionsBlock`, and `plugin-dashboard` `DashboardFilterBar`, all of which go through `translateOptions`.
  - Checked and not a chip: the `/apps/:app/:object` equality arm (`objectViewListUrlState.ts`, `parseUrlEqualityFilterTriples`) draws no comparand chip.
- Landing: the zone merges main first (K ≥ 15); a merge-only head move keeps this ACCEPT.
